name: חֶלְקָי
summary: A priest in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, head of the father's house of Meremoth. The name is חֵלֶק “portion” with the ending ‑ay, most likely a short form of Hilkiah, “my portion is Yahweh”, which is the name of another priestly house in the same list (Neh 12:21).

evidence.note: “In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers' houses.”
“Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah”: the full form in the same list.

note: Takes h.da.ag (1 token). The ‑ay ending as a short form of a ‑yahu name is the usual reading (compare Shimei, Zabbai), not stated by any verse.
